figures.finding: No child (under sixteen) may be employed in Montserrat, but the ban does not reach artistic performances the Minister approves, on conditions the Governor in Cabinet sets after consulting the Labour Advisory Board; a young person (sixteen or seventeen) may not work at night (22:00 onward). The conditions (hours, schooling, chaperones) were not found published. The exception names performances, not writing or directing.

value.performerRoute: Minister's approval of the artistic performance
value.conditionsSetBy: Governor acting on the advice of the Cabinet, after consulting the Labour Advisory Board

sources.said: 91. (1) A person shall not employ, or permit a child to be employed, as an employee. … (3) This section shall not apply to— (a) light work approved by the Minister for children of the age of fourteen years and over and subject to the number of hours and other conditions determined by the Minister after consultation with Labour Advisory Board, where practicable; (b) artistic performances approved by the Minister and subject to conditions determined by the Governor, acting on the advice of the Cabinet, after consultation with the Labour Advisory Board, where practicable;

“child” means a person under the age of sixteen years; … no young person shall be employed or work during the night in any public or private undertaking, other than an undertaking in which only members of the same family are employed.

figures.finding: No one under eighteen may apply to incorporate a company or be appointed its director.

sources.said: (2) An individual may not apply to incorporate a company under this Act if the individual— (a) is less than eighteen years of age; … 140. (1) A person is disqualified from being appointed as a director of a company if the person— … (a) is an individual who is under eighteen years of age;
